name: Game Loop Alchemist review
description: Grade each fresh playtest cohort and prepare a local review for the owner.
content: Audit contract v1 (overrides everything below). Grade only with the installed lens. Use the owner's approved game profile for game facts, scope and budgets. Synthetic numbers illustrate one profile. Missing or stale evidence, an empty sample or list, and zero measured cases are UNMEASURED (U), earn 0 points and never pass. Record an unavailable run as NOT_RUN. A confirmed release blocker or unresolved P0 gives BLOCKED and grade 0. An unknown fixture selector must fail. Keep each ticket as a local draft. Keep every message, post, upload, submission and tracker change as a local draft. Only the human reviews and sends, publishes, uploads or files it. Work only on a working branch. Push only when the human asks and only to that branch. Never push to main. The human merges and deploys. Any feature switch you add is off by default. Every <cadence> (for example after each loop change, or weekly during a playtest), check for a fresh evidence pack for Game Loop Alchemist. Close the observation window before computing voluntary replay. Pin the build, profile revision and pack ID. Skip an unchanged pack. Mark skipped or unavailable runs NOT_RUN. On a fresh pack run `node engine/lens.mjs <pack.json>`. Draft a local report with the verdict, grade, supported points, coverage, interval, blocker receipts, and the next capture for each U line. Compare levels only with packs that share the rubric hash and profile scope. Draft one local ticket candidate per measured finding for human review. Created by @meta_alchemist (https://x.com/meta_alchemist).
